[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Lean

def implementation (string: String) (n: Nat) : Nat :=
let [x, y, z] := string.split " " in
let x' := x.parse Nat 0 in
let y' := y.parse Nat 0 in
n - (x' + y')
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma parse_split
(s: String)
(x: Nat)
(h: s.split " " = [x.repr, " apples and ", (s.drop x.repr.length).drop " apples and ".length.repr]) :
s = x.repr ++ " apples and " ++ (s.drop x.repr.length).drop " apples and ".length.repr :=
by
simp [s.split " "]

lemma parse_split_eq_self
(s: String)
(x: Nat)
(h: s.split " " = [x.repr, " apples and ", (s.drop x.repr.length).drop " apples and ".length.repr]) :
s = x.repr ++ " apples and " ++ (s.drop x.repr.length).drop " apples and ".length.repr :=
by
simp [s.split " "]

lemma parse_split_apple_orange
(s: String)
(x: Nat)
(y: Nat)
(h: s.split " " = [x.repr, " apples and ", y.repr]) :
s = x.repr ++ " apples and " ++ y.repr :=
by
simp [s.split " "]

lemma parse_split_eq_self_apple_orange
(s: String)
(x: Nat)
(y: Nat)
(h: s.split " " = [x.repr, " apples and ", y.repr]) :
s = x.repr ++ " apples and " ++ y.repr :=
by
simp [s.split " "]

lemma split_length
(s: String)
(h: s.split " " = [x.repr, " apples and ", y.repr]) :
s.length = x.repr.length + " apples and ".length + y.repr.length :=
by
simp [s.split " "]

lemma split_length_apple_orange
(s: String)
(x: Nat)
(y: Nat)
(h: s.split " " = [x.repr, " apples and ", y.repr]) :
s.length = x.repr.length + " apples and ".length + y.repr.length :=
by
simp [s.split " "]

lemma length_split
(s: String)
(x: Nat)
(y: Nat)
(h: s.split " " = [x.repr, " apples and ", y.repr]) :
s.length = x.repr.length + " apples and ".length + y.repr.length :=
by
simp [s.split " "]

[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation string n
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
existsi x, y
split
  -- x + y = n - result
  suffices h1: x + y = n - result by
    simp [h1]
  simp [result]
  simp [x, y]
  simp [n - result]
  linarith
  -- String.join [x.repr, " apples and ", y.repr, " oranges"] = string
  simp [String.join [x.repr, " apples and ", y.repr, " oranges"]]
  simp [string]
  simp [x, y]
  simp [x.repr, " apples and ", y.repr, " oranges"]
  linarith
[END]
